sources.summary: NOTE: page not retrievable at fetch time (HTTP 401, paywall); the underlying wire report (25 Aug 2022) covers Indonesian police denying violence in the death of Peruvian trans activist and Harvard affiliate Rodrigo Ventocilla in Bali following an arrest on drug charges.

Harvard Crimson feature (1 Sep 2022): mother of trans rights organiser Rodrigo Ventocilla Ventosilla, 32, says her son was beaten and extorted for up to USD 200,000 after arrest on drug charges at an airport in Indonesia; he died three days later in a Denpasar hospital while in police custody; Indonesian police deny violence.

The Diplomat feature (Aug 2026): vigilante mobs attacked trans women across Indonesia in a 14-16 July 2026 wave, including over 15 trans women doused, stripped and beaten in Bogor with footage shared online; an October 2025 presidential decree lists "the promotion of LGBTQ+ culture" among nonmilitary threats alongside terrorism, radicalism and drug addiction; legal gender change requires sex reassignment surgery plus judicial approval; provincial moral laws and Aceh caning remain the enforcement texture; a researcher documents markedly hardened anti-queer attitudes since 2016.
